# Ayu Mirage

Ayu Mirage mixes an Ayu-inspired palette with soft gradients and traffic-light accents, crediting the Pisium and Traffic Lights themes as influences. Alongside the colours it makes small layout refinements and keeps contrast consistent across the interface.

![Ayu Mirage screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bcdavasconcelos/Obsidian-Ayu_Mirage/HEAD/ayu1.png)

```cue

    name:   "Ayu Mirage"

}
```
